impact: nvEncRegisterResource will fail with NV_ENC_ERR_INVALID_DEVICE if DXGI capture creates its own D3D11 device instead of using encoder/d3d11_device.rs shared_device(). Zero-copy pipeline silently breaks when T-048/T-051 real DXGI capture is implemented.
title: NVENC D3D11 interop requires shared device with DXGI capture backend
